comments.text: I expected beautiful scenery, but I didn't expect such a fascinating mix of old traditions and modern life. It's amazing how one place can feel like it's living in two different centuries at the same time.

comments.author: @RealLifeFilesDoc
comments.text: The anthropological depth of this script is phenomenal. Explaining the Montenegrin concept of "Polako" not as laziness, but as a deep, geographical philosophy—where you understand that the mountain has been there for a million years so there's no need to rush [05:35]—is such a profound realization. And the detail about hosts welcoming guests by pouring Rakia directly into their hands rather than a glass [10:33] is the rawest, most beautiful form of hospitality I've ever heard of. Beautifully researched! 👏
